# Classify Group batches before dock projection

## Context

The [runtime correlation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5595091021) identifies why the nested Workstation splitter witness loses its column before Escape: a Group resize reaches refresh classification as `{operations: [resizeSplit], workspaceKey}`, but the classifier reads only the scalar `operation` field.

The [controlled single-operation delegation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5595136053) keeps every original E2E assertion and changes only classification in the disposable app. It passes the complete test, with `geometryOnly:true`, `landedInPlace:true`, and the same column/splitter through reverse movement and Escape.

## The Problem

On `dev@335b2ca43a`, the array descriptor produces both fast-path flags false. The resize queues behind the preceding structural projection, then stages replacement chrome while the next pointer press is arming. Root-motion absence and correct preview geometry do not protect the captured ids.

This is a lost classification at the real Group consumer boundary, not a stable-topology validator refusal. No first-introducing commit is attributed.

## The Architectural Reality

`WorkspaceSet.commit` owns the operations-array descriptor. `Workspace.projectDockCommit` forwards it with captured/preservation context. `Workspace.getRefreshOptions` consumes operation change classes from `Operations.changeClassFor`; `Reconciler` remains the final structural validator of any fast-path request.

The earlier `#18472` batch handling belongs to Maximize's ordered-neutrality decision and does not classify reconciliation. Group writes, history and persisted documents are separate authorities and need no change here.

## The Fix

Extend the existing engine refresh classifier to consume the whole operations batch through `Operations.changeClassFor`. Admit a nonempty homogeneous `geometry` batch as geometry-only and a homogeneous `itemFlags` batch as retained topology. Homogeneity means change class, not identical operation names. Mixed, unknown, empty or malformed batches use full reconciliation. Preserve scalar behavior and never mutate the descriptor.

Use the existing Workspace unit/integration fixtures and the unchanged nested E2E. Keep one classification authority; no new operation-name table, manager policy, helper module or app-side batch special case. Shorten the existing classifier commentary while documenting the lasting rule.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine refresh classification | Operations.changeClassFor plus Group descriptor | Classify every batch entry; emit the existing fast-path request only for one homogeneous class | Mixed/unknown/empty/malformed retains full projection | getRefreshOptions JSDoc | Table controls and real Group projection |
| Stable geometry projection | Reconciler structural validation | A valid Group resize retains shell/chrome and applies final geometry | Structural mismatch still stages normally | Existing validator contract | Group integration plus unchanged headed nested journey |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Homogeneous geometry and item-flag batches produce the corresponding existing refresh option; scalar behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] Mixed classes, unknown operations, empty and malformed batches remain on full projection, with no descriptor mutation.
- [ ] Real Group/WorkspaceSet projection receives the classification and retains valid geometry-only chrome while updating geometry. Existing validator-refusal behavior remains intact.
- [ ] The complete unchanged WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL test passes headed with explicit Brain runtime, including active-FLIP admission, reverse preview, Escape, pane identity and document checks.
- [ ] Focused and full unit checks pass; retain the failing baseline and successful controlled/runtime evidence.

## Out of Scope

Transaction ordering/history, Maximize policy, asynchronous drop cleanup, new APIs or files, and test relaxation. Workstation already honors `base.geometryOnly`; its separate override dropping `base.retainTopology` is tracked by `#18208` and remains untouched, so this leaf makes no Workstation lock-path claim. The edge/grid witness settlement PRs remain separate.

## Decision Record impact

Aligned with ADR 0029 §2.1's engine-owned projection and preserved pane identity; no authority amendment.
